title: Verify and implement Laya labeled-context support
description:
## Scope

Investigate the upstream Laya interface and Biased-Decisions integration before replacing the current NotImplementedError. Implement an explicit, documented context serialization if supported; otherwise retain zero-shot support and a declared few-shot exclusion.

## Definition of done

Fake-model conformance specs cover zero-shot and the verified context path, or assert a precise unsupported-capability reason; default model loading and version provenance are documented.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Verify and implement Laya labeled-context support
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given a Laya installation has a documented context capability
    When the caller requests a few-shot decision
    Then the adapter uses the supported serialization or returns the recorded exclusion reason
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Inspected installed upstream Laya 0.3.21 Agent and load signatures. Retained supported zero-shot path, version/revision provenance and tokenizer truncation guard. Labeled context has no documented upstream demonstration semantics and is explicitly excluded, as permitted by this story. Fake conformance covers exclusion before inference. Loading a pinned live checkpoint remains a separate approved pilot.
